purpose: Outcome-aware follow-up to the prior exact incremental-boundary holdout. Test whether periodic or allocation/live-triggered fresh rebuilds can retain exact rank vectors while controlling stale-node accumulation and total runtime. Protocol is frozen before these new holdout outcomes.

holdout.game: generated monotone simple game from subset-minimal random supports using the same generator family as the prior incremental holdout
holdout.observation_stream: seeded sample without replacement from all coalitions

strategies.always_incremental: Conjoin only newly strengthening boundary clauses into one persistent ROBDD; never rebuild.
strategies.always_rebuild: After every effective boundary update, discard the strategy manager and fresh-rebuild from the current reduced maximal-zero/minimal-one boundary before rank evaluation.
strategies.periodic_32: Use incremental updates but fresh-rebuild after every 32 effective boundary changes since the last rebuild.
strategies.ratio_4: Use incremental updates; after an effective update, compute allocated_nonterminal_nodes / max(1, reachable_live_nonterminal_nodes) and fresh-rebuild before rank evaluation when the ratio is at least 4.
strategies.hybrid_ratio4_or_64: Use incremental updates; fresh-rebuild when allocation/live ratio is at least 4 or 64 effective boundary changes have occurred since the last rebuild, whichever happens first.

correctness_oracle: At every effective update, independently fresh-rebuild from the reduced boundary and require exact equality of the full cardinality/rank-count vector for every strategy. Oracle construction time is validation overhead and excluded from strategy-runtime comparisons.

primary: ROBDD nonterminal allocations created by the strategy
memory_proxy: maximum allocated/live ratio before optional rebuild
maximum allocated nodes in current manager
cost_accounting.reporting: Report runtime and memory proxies separately; no scalar utility is fit after outcomes. A strategy Pareto-dominates another only if it is no slower and no worse on max allocated/live ratio with at least one strict improvement, within this exact implementation.

predeclared_tests: All strategies must have zero exact-rank mismatches at every effective update; any mismatch invalidates that cell's performance comparison.
Compare always_incremental versus always_rebuild to establish the endpoints of the rebuild tradeoff.
Compare periodic_32 and ratio_4 against both endpoints; report whether the trigger reduces stale-node accumulation without paying always-rebuild cost.
Compare hybrid_ratio4_or_64 to ratio_4 to test whether a periodic backstop adds value when allocation/live remains deceptively low.
Do not infer general asymptotic complexity from Python wall-clock or these generated monotone games.
Do not apply these monotone-boundary results to nonmonotone finite-compute proof utility without a separate validated monotonicity contract.
scope: Twelve newly seeded generated monotone simple-game observation streams; exact only for this boundary-CNF/ROBDD implementation and rank-count query.
